learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to express our love and respect for our country through art and understand the beauty of our National Symbols!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Our beautiful Tiranga has three colors! Saffron at the top for bravery, white in the middle for peace, and green at the bottom for nature.
When we hear the National Anthem, we stand very straight and still to show respect. We can draw ourselves standing proudly next to our flag!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Beautiful Tiranga
fun_activity.instructions: Draw our National Flag waving in the wind. Remember to draw the blue Ashoka Chakra with 24 spokes right in the middle of the white band!

quick_recap: ⭐ We always stand straight and still when singing the National Anthem.
⭐ Our National Flag is called the Tiranga because it has three bright colors.
⭐ Art is a wonderful way to show how much we love our country!
